title: Terms.
bodyText: The intermediate appellate court shall be deemed always to be in continuous session. The court shall be deemed always open for filing papers, issuing and returning process, and issuing orders.
bodyHtml: §602-53  Terms.  The intermediate appellate court shall be deemed always to be in continuous session.  The court shall be deemed always open for filing papers, issuing and returning process, and issuing orders. [L 1979, c 111, pt of §3; am L 1984, c 106, §2]
